row.name: Centuri Holdings Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=7 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.78 tightness=1.25 base_volume_vs_leg=0.43 base_volume_vs_avg=0.58
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: the base gave back 0.78 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 3.6% vs its 20-SMA, 9.8% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 21.5% in 5 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: The single most decisive flaw is the recorded C FAIL: the base gave back 0.78 of the prior leg (threshold 0.34) and tightness measured 1.25 against a 1.0 ceiling, meaning the seven-session consolidation visible in the shaded box is wide and overlapping rather than the tight, shallow pause Bonde requires. The signal bar itself is honest — closing at 96% of its range above the open — and the prior leg is genuinely linear (ER 1.0, R² 0.8 in five sessions), but the loose base is a clear, measured quality defect that prevents an A grade.
claude.key_risk: A base that gave back 78% of the leg with above-average tightness means the consolidation lacked the orderly compression needed for reliable follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the prior session's high or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the burst day's midpoint (~21.40).
